title: Kiritani Haruka — A Street-style Idol?!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's been so long since I last visited this place... Actually, when was the last time I did?)
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Welcome... Hey, Haruka!
What's up?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry for the sudden intrusion, but I really just happened to be in the neighborhood.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, Haruka. It's been a while.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, hello. Yes, it really has.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Here, have a seat.
Go ahead and take a break for a while, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yay, thanks!
Haruka, over here!
Weekend Garage Stage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, the tables in the back here should give us a little more privacy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Want anything to drink? It'll be on me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you sure about that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I mean it!
Anything you like!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'll have some milk tea.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sure thing!
Coming right up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here you are.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you even made yourself one.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad said I could take a break for a while...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is just his way of saying, “Go take care of Haruka for me!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, An.

rows.Speaker: Haruka & An
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, the other day was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When the four of us went out together?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! It was really nice to talk about what we used to do during elementary school too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which! I forgot to tell them about the time you brought that bright blue penguin-shaped lunchbox to school!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You always bring that up when we talk about stuff like this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To me, you'll always be that girl with the bright blue penguin-shaped lunchbox who secretly eats early lunches with a huge grin on her face during class.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Th-That was when I was in my penguin craze...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
The people in class were so taken aback.
Some were even wondering if food that blue was even edible!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Some of them said it looked cute, though...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? They did?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! But it's such a classic!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
While we're on the subject...
Remember what happened during the sports competition when we were in the fifth and sixth grade?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Fifth and sixth grade...?
Are you talking about when you outran me?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You and I were supposed to have a duel as the anchors for our respective classes during the relay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I ended up finishing first because my classmates got the baton to me much sooner than yours...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was like, “I would've had you if we had another lap to go!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And after that I yelled, “We're having a rematch next year, Haruka! I'm not letting you win next time!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was pretty upset about losing, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I had to leave partway through the next year because of work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry it had to be that way, An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Why are you apologizing?
Work is work, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Both of my parents work, so I totally get it. They've been telling me the same thing my entire life.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, sure, I was bummed out by what happened, but I'm not mad or anything.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You aren't...? That's a relief.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And thank you for remembering what we did back then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How can I forget? That's like one of the best things we ever did together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come to think of it... Isn't that when you really started working out, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right... I was still little, so I really couldn't do much back then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you're still working out regularly, right? I guess I shouldn't expect anything less.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
I probably wouldn't stand a chance against you right now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh? Should I take that as a challenge...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Maybe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Again, I'm not mad about you not racing me then, but we've left things undecided, you know?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, wanna have a quick race at the park?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, are you sure?
People might see you and say online that, “Haruka Kiritani's running like crazy at the park!!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, right.

rows.Speaker: Haruka & An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.
